messages:
Ava (Product): starting a focused PRD review for observability: retention + trace UX. goal: a clear launch-gates checklist, acceptance criteria, and a short ‘scope ledger’ that we can sign off on by EOD Wed. please read the proposed gates below and flag any blockers.

Sam (Eng): copying the sketch you posted. quick note: we need to lock the query performance budget before we promise dashboard latency. suggest p95 < 250ms for single-route queries at 75th percentile traffic. is that doable? @maria please weigh in on infra risk.

Maria (SRE): p95 <250ms seems tight for index-heavy trace queries unless we add a sampling index. if we scope initial launch to 30d retention with on-demand archive for older data we can hit it. main risk is cross-tenant heavy tail queries. recommend circuit breaker for >10k span queries / 1m window.

Jon (Design): UX constraints: admin should be able to create retention rules and preview affected routes. wireframes: a compact rule editor + 3-step preview modal. need copy for edge cases (overlapping rules). I'll attach a GIF soon.

Priya (Analytics): cost target for launch: <= $0.08 per 1k traces ingested (storage+ingest), with retention tiering (hot 7d, warm 30d, cold archive). we'll need sample datasets to validate. also we should include an analytics KPIs doc: storage delta, query latency, tail error rate.

Ava (Product): proposed launch gates (WIP):
- feature parity: create/edit retention rule UI + preview modal
- metrics: p95 query latency <250ms, error rate <1% for dashboard queries
- cost: validated on 3 workloads, cost per trace within 10% of estimate
- rollout: canary (5% orgs) then 25% then 100% with auto-rollback on SLO breach
- smoke tests: ingest synthetic traffic and run the acceptance prompt set (see below)

Sam (Eng): acceptance prompt set (examples):
```
1) Create rule: route = "/api/v1/generate" -> retention = 7d
2) Create overlapping rule: route = "/api/*" -> retention = 30d -> system should pick most specific
3) Query: trace by trace_id within 7d -> returns full spans in <250ms
4) Query old trace in archive (45d) -> returns link to restore flow
```

Maria (SRE): edge cases to call out:
- overlapping rules with conflicting TTLs (admin precedence vs specificity)
- deleted routes that still have retention metadata -> cleanup job needed
- long-running traces (>1M tokens/spans) -> sampling/partial indexing rules
- concurrent edits to same rule (last-write-wins? optimistic lock?)

Jon (Design): UX edgecases:
- when a preview shows >1000 affected routes, show a summary and require confirmation
- admin needs a simulated cost estimate in the modal (Priya can wire the numbers)
- permission-levels: only org admins can create global rules; project leads can create per-project

Ava (Product): open decisions we need to resolve in this thread:
- precedence model for overlapping rules (specificity vs admin override) -> propose specificity wins, admin can pin (override)
- retention tiers for traces vs logs vs metrics -> keep separate product-level defaults, allow overrides per-route
- rollout cadence and canary SLO thresholds -> propose 5%/25%/100% with auto-rollback on error rate >1.5% or latency p95 > 350ms for 10m window

Sam (Eng): implementation notes:
- timeline: we can do a minimal backend + UI for the editor in 3 sprints if we scope cold archive as out-of-scope for initial GA
- storage migration: need a job to reconcile legacy rules, estimate 48h run for 200M route-mappings
- API: we'll expose POST /v1/retention-rules and GET /v1/retention-preview?route=...

Priya (Analytics): I'll prepare two sample workloads (startup-traffic, enterprise-burst) and a cost validation script. assign to me. also +1 on showing simulated cost in the preview.

Maria (SRE): testing plan addendum:
- chaos test: simulate a node outage during canary and validate fallback to degraded-mode (no preview but queries still readable)
- quota enforcement: ensure per-org rate limiter triggers and we surface a clear error to the UI

Ava (Product): action items:
- Sam: confirm API contract + feasibility for 3 sprints, deadline Tue EOD (assigned)
- Jon: upload wireframes + modal copy, deadline Tue noon
- Priya: sample workloads and cost script, deadline Wed EOD
- Maria: SLI definitions + chaos test plan, deadline Wed EOD
- @all: comment on precedence model by EOD today -> default = specificity wins + admin pin override

deploy-bot: commit 0d3fa4c -> branch prd/retention-ui-proposal (link: https://git.internal/r/1234) :rocket:

Sam (Eng): noted. small ask: we should include a developer-facing API doc with examples (curl + python) in the PRD. I'll add a draft.

Jon (Design): uploaded GIF and two wireframe variants: one compact, one expanded. leaving a note on the preview copy about cost.

Ava (Product): thanks all. if no major objections I'll convert this thread into the PRD checklist doc and open the RFC on Thurs. final call: precedence = specificity then pinned overrides.

Priya (Analytics): no objections from me. I'll attach cost runbooks after I finish the scripts.

Maria (SRE): ack. will add the circuit-breaker config to the RFC.

Ava (Product): wrapping up — anyone blocked on dependencies?

Sam (Eng): blocked on infra quota increase for canary (request filed, ticket INF-778). if that doesn't land we need to reduce canary to 2%.

Ava (Product): ok noted. I'll follow up with infra. final item: please annotate this thread with any small PR links you create so we can track progress.
